body.statement: Li and Zhao's Gaussian coverage theorem for the adaptive design-based AIPW estimator uses a Lindeberg-type negligible-increment condition; its conclusion is not asserted for critical rare-arm arrays whose normalized late increments remain nonnegligible.

source.verbatim_statement: Condition 3(ii): $\lambda_{\min}(V_{\mathrm{aipw}})^{-1} \cdot T^{-1}\max_{1\le t\le T} (L_t + M_t)^2/\underline e_t^2 = o(1)$. Theorem 4(ii): If Condition 3 holds, then the standardized AIPW estimator converges to the standard normal distribution.
